ref: #2 §5 Constants: CopyValue "For a frequently occurring element, copies the value at a defined position in the source structure to the assigned target field" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bfbd16f66d33de4e10000000a42189e.html]; assumed reading of #79: the position counts from 0 in each context of the input, and a context without a value at the position gives an empty context; obs-constant decides it
note: copyValue{position=1} over Sku in context Order, a, b, c | d | e, f: each context gives its second value, b | (empty) | f, so o2's Item has no V: d has no value at position 1. Counting from 1 would give a | d | e.
